records.jp: えっ……日菜子？
records.en_original: Huh... Hinako?
records.en: Huh... Hinako?

records.jp: 私からの紹介は不要だと思うが、彼女は白井日菜子。<CR>ＡＡＳＡの戦闘員だ
records.en_original: I don't think she needs an introduction, but this is Hinako Shirai. She's a member of the AASA.
records.en: I don't think she needs an introduction, but this is Shirai Hinako. She's a member of the AASA.

records.jp: 平原さんと同じ……<CR>じゃあ、司令が仰っていた派遣予定の人員って……
records.en_original: Just like Hiori. So that means, she's one of the people you mentioned would be dispatched here?
records.en: Just like Hirahara-san. So that means, she's one of the people you mentioned would be dispatched here?

records.jp: ああ、彼女はそのうちの一人だ
records.en_original: Yeah, she's one of them.
records.en: Yeah, she's one of them.

records.jp: この度、ＡＡＳＡが出雲管区一帯の灰地域を<CR>調査するそうでな。情報交換のために来校してもらった
records.en_original: The AASA is conducting an investigation of the Ashen Zone around the Izumo District. She's here to exchange information.
records.en: The AASA is conducting an investigation of the Ashen Zone around the Izumo District. She's here to exchange information.

records.jp: うちの部隊の話をしたら、春日と友人と聞いてな。<CR>よければ学校を案内してやってくれ
records.en_original: When I mentioned our unit, I was told you were friends with Shiho. If you have time, could you show her around the school?
records.en: When I mentioned our unit, I was told you were friends with Shiho. If you have time, could you show her around the school?

records.jp: 久しぶりだね、詩帆。<CR>また会えて嬉しいよ
records.en_original: It's been a while, Shiho. I'm glad we could meet again.
records.en: It's been a while, Shiho. I'm glad we could meet again.

records.jp: 数年ぶりだね。<CR>まさか、こんな形で再会するとは思わなかったけど
records.en_original: It's been years, hasn't it? I never imagined we'd run into each other like this.
records.en: It's been years, hasn't it? I never imagined we'd run into each other like this.

records.jp: うん……灰病、大丈夫？
records.en_original: Yeah... Are you holding up okay? Your Ash Syndrome, I mean.
records.en: Yeah... Are you holding up okay? Your Ash Syndrome, I mean.

records.jp: たぶん……どうなんだろう？<CR>わたしもそこまで詳しくはわからないんだ
records.en_original: I think so? I'm not really sure. I don't know all that much about it myself.
records.en: I think so? I'm not really sure. I don't know all that much about it myself.

records.jp: っていうか、ＡＡＳＡならもう知ってるのかな？<CR>わたしが変身できること
records.en_original: But since you're part of AASA, you probably already know, right? That I can transform.
records.en: But since you're part of AASA, you probably already know, right? That I can transform.

records.jp: もちろん。コズミックファング奪還のための活躍も、<CR>さっきあやかさんから聞いた……頑張ったんだね
records.en_original: Of course. I just heard from Ayaka about how hard you're working to take the Cosmic Fang back. You're really doing your best.
records.en: Of course. I just heard from Ayaka-san about how hard you're working to take the Cosmic Fang back. You're really doing your best.

records.jp: ……うん。<CR>怖い気持ちは強いけど……やらないとだから……
records.en_original: Yeah. I'm still really scared, but I have to do this.
records.en: Yeah. I'm still really scared, but I have to do this.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: そういえば、近くに来てたから呼び出したって<CR>先生が言ってたけど、何かの用事で来てたの？
records.en_original: Oh yeah, the teacher said you were called over because you were nearby, but did you have something to do here?
records.en: Oh yeah, the teacher said you were called over because you were nearby, but did you have something to do here?

records.jp: あ、うん。ちょっとした用事だったんだけど……
records.en_original: Oh, yeah. I just had a little errand to run.
records.en: Oh, yeah. I just had a little errand to run.

records.jp: でも、もう終わったから戻るところだったの
records.en_original: But it's already done, so I was just about to head back.
records.en: But it's already done, so I was just about to head back.

records.jp: そっか。日菜子も色々、忙しそうだね
records.en_original: I see. Seems like you're pretty busy too, Hinako.
records.en: I see. Seems like you're pretty busy too, Hinako.

records.jp: まあね。けど、そのおかげで詩帆と再会できたから。<CR>悪いことばかりじゃないよ
records.en_original: I guess so. But, thanks to that, I got to see you again, Shiho. It's not all bad.
records.en: I guess so. But, thanks to that, I got to see you again, Shiho. It's not all bad.

records.jp: 今度会うときは、またコーヒーを飲みたいな。<CR>詩帆の家……“喫茶ラタン”で飲んだコーヒーを
records.en_original: Next time we meet, I want to drink coffee again. I'd love a cup from your place, Cafe Rattan.
records.en: Next time we meet, I want to drink coffee again. I'd love a cup from your place, Cafe Rattan.

records.jp: ふふ、用意して待ってる。<CR>飲みたくなったら、いつでも来てね
records.en_original: Hehe, I'm always ready if you're willing. If you ever want coffee, just swing by anytime.
records.en: Hehe, I'm always ready if you're willing. If you ever want coffee, just swing by anytime.

records.jp: コズミックファングに行くの？
records.en_original: Are you going to the Cosmic Fang?
records.en: Are you going to the Cosmic Fang?

records.jp: あの辺りは異灰もクイーンもいっぱいいる。<CR>しかも他の地域より断然強い
records.en_original: That area's crawling with both the Testa and Queens. And they're way stronger than anywhere else.
records.en: That area's crawling with both the Testa and Queens. And they're way stronger than anywhere else.

records.jp: 一人で行くなんて、危険すぎるよ
records.en_original: It's way too dangerous to go alone.
records.en: It's way too dangerous to go alone.

records.jp: 詩帆……どうしてわかったの？
records.en_original: Shiho... How did you know?
records.en: Shiho... How did you know?

records.jp: ＡＡＳＡに所属してて、コズミックファングに<CR>近いここに用事で来た
records.en_original: You're with the AASA, so I figured the Cosmic Fang was related to what you had to do here since it's nearby.
records.en: You're with the AASA, so I figured the Cosmic Fang was related to what you had to do here since it's nearby.

records.jp: ちょっとした用事な感じしないなぁ、って思って。<CR>わたしも、似たような立場だし
records.en_original: It didn't really seem like you were just on a little errand. I'm in a pretty similar situation myself, after all.
records.en: It didn't really seem like you were just on a little errand. I'm in a pretty similar situation myself, after all.

records.jp: コズミックファング……あれはね、私たちの今いる<CR>現実世界と、精神世界「コモン」を繋ぐ塔なの
records.en_original: The Cosmic Fang... That's actually a tower that connects our world and the Common—the world of the mind.
records.en: The Cosmic Fang... That's actually a tower that connects our world and the Common—the world of the mind.

records.jp: そのコモンには、私の友達がいる。<CR>コモンの管理者の、ユズとライムっていう子が……
records.en_original: I have friends in the Common. Two girls named Yuzu and Lime, who manage and protect it...
records.en: I have friends in the Common. Two girls named Yuzu and Lime, who manage and protect it...

records.jp: あの灰に覆われている様子からして、<CR>たぶん二人とも、かなり切羽詰まった状態なんだと思う
records.en_original: Judging by how covered in Ash it is, I think both of them are probably in a really tight spot right now.
records.en: Judging by how covered in Ash it is, I think both of them are probably in a really tight spot right now.

records.jp: だから、放っておくことなんてできない。<CR>二人を助けに行きたいの
records.en_original: So, I can't just leave things like this. I want to go help them.
records.en: So, I can't just leave things like this. I want to go help them.

records.jp: ねえ、日菜子。<CR>勝手に約束していい？
records.en_original: Hey, Hinako. Can I make a selfish promise?
records.en: Hey, Hinako. Can I make a selfish promise?

records.jp: コズミックファングはわたしたちが奪還する
records.en_original: We'll be the ones to take back the Cosmic Fang.
records.en: We'll be the ones to take back the Cosmic Fang.

records.jp: そして、日菜子を二人と会わせる
records.en_original: And, I promise you'll get to meet them, Hinako.
records.en: And, I promise you'll get to meet them, Hinako.

records.jp: だからお願い。<CR>それまで、ちょっとだけ待ってもらえないかな？
records.en_original: So please. Could you just wait a little longer until then?
records.en: So please. Could you just wait a little longer until then?

records.jp: 詩帆……
records.en_original: Shiho...
records.en: Shiho...

records.jp: ………日菜子にとって、その二人は本当に大事な<CR>友達なんでしょ？
records.en_original: Those two are really important friends to you, right?
records.en: Those two are really important friends to you, right?

records.jp: でも、もし二人に再会した時、<CR>日菜子が傷だらけで苦しんでいたら
records.en_original: But, if you did meet them again, and you were all hurt and suffering...
records.en: But, if you did meet them again, and you were all hurt and suffering...

records.jp: 二人はきっと悲しむんじゃないかな
records.en_original: I think they'd be really sad to see you like that.
records.en: I think they'd be really sad to see you like that.

records.jp: ……少なくとも、わたしは悲しいよ
records.en_original: At least, I know I would be.
records.en: At least, I know I would be.

records.jp: ……ふふっ。<CR>詩帆、変わったね
records.en_original: Hehe. You've changed, Shiho.
records.en: Hehe. You've changed, Shiho.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 前会った時より、だいぶたくましくなってる気がする
records.en_original: You seem a lot stronger than when we last met.
records.en: You seem a lot stronger than when we last met.

records.jp: そ、そうかな？
records.en_original: R-really?
records.en: R-really?

records.jp: でも、もしそうだとしたら……
records.en_original: But if that's true...
records.en: But if that's true...

records.jp: 部隊の皆さんのおかげ、かな
records.en_original: I think it's thanks to everyone in the unit.
records.en: I think it's thanks to everyone in the unit.

records.jp: いい仲間に出会ったんだね
records.en_original: Sounds like you found some really good friends.
records.en: Sounds like you found some really good friends.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: コズミックファングは、<CR>詩帆と日ノ杜のみんなに任せるよ
records.en_original: I'll leave the Cosmic Fang to you and everyone in Hinomori.
records.en: I'll leave the Cosmic Fang to you and everyone in Hinomori.

records.jp: よろしく頼むね、詩帆。<CR>けど、気を付けて
records.en_original: I'm counting on you, Shiho. But be careful, okay?
records.en: I'm counting on you, Shiho. But be careful, okay?

records.jp: ありがとう、日菜子。<CR>絶対、わたしたちが奪還してみせるよ
records.en_original: Thank you, Hinako. I promise, we'll take it back, no matter what.
records.en: Thank you, Hinako. I promise, we'll take it back, no matter what.

records.jp: うん……それとね、もう一つ報告があるの
records.en_original: Yeah... Oh, and one more thing I wanted to tell you.
records.en: Yeah... Oh, and one more thing I wanted to tell you.

records.jp: 私、これからしばらくはＡＡＳＡの仕事で、<CR>日ノ杜の方に来る用事が結構増えそうなんだ
records.en_original: From now on, I think I'll be coming around Hinomori a lot more for AASA work.
records.en: From now on, I think I'll be coming around Hinomori a lot more for AASA work.

records.jp: えっ、そうなの？
records.en_original: Wait, really?
records.en: Wait, really?

records.jp: うん。その時は学校を待機所として使っていいって、<CR>あやかさんから許可ももらえたの
records.en_original: Yeah. Ayaka even gave me permission to use the school as a place to stand by at when I'm here.
records.en: Yeah. Ayaka-san even gave me permission to use the school as a place to stand by at when I'm here.

records.jp: 忙しいんだね、ＡＡＳＡの仕事
records.en_original: Sounds like you're busy with AASA stuff.
records.en: Sounds like you're busy with AASA stuff.

records.jp: まあね。けど、そのおかげで詩帆の淹れたコーヒーを<CR>意外と早く飲めそうだから、私としては嬉しいかな
records.en_original: I guess so. But thanks to that, it means I'll probably get to taste your coffee again sooner than I thought, so I'm actually kind of happy.
records.en: I guess so. But thanks to that, it means I'll probably get to taste your coffee again sooner than I thought, so I'm actually kind of happy.

records.jp: ふふっ、美味しいの用意して待ってるね
records.en_original: Hehe, I'll have something yummy ready and waiting.
records.en: Hehe, I'll have something yummy ready and waiting.
